Dear Energu Support,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Ankita
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center - ERK
Main Asset
:
MP / R4 170001715
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
We0Dpl
Problem Description
: Technical query
We reviewed the logs for the session that was not started at the time you provided. After our investigation, we found that the issue appears to be related to the RFID card. Specifically, it seems that the card is blocked. This may be because it is not white-listed with the backend system or possibly expired.
We recommend checking the status of the RFID card to verify if this is the cause. There were no other issues identified on our end.
Let us know if you need further assistance.
For future reference, your case number is
0401565
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
